info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Model Retrieval API provides access to specific wholesale trading models based on given parameters. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about trading models, enabling businesses to analyze and leverage wholesale trading strategies effectively. Typical consumers include financial analysts, traders, and developers integrating trading functionalities into their systems. By utilizing this API, users can obtain tailored trading insights that support informed decision-making in the wholesale market.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about a specific trading model identified by its unique ID. Use this to get comprehensive information regarding the trading model's structure and parameters.
